generatedFrom: fexli/ArknightsResource — spine/{charId}/{stem}/{Front,Back}/ (dir listing, via the GitHub contents API)
meta.note: Only skins whose Spine model directory exists upstream, and only for the pool operators of 07-assets.json. Default outfits (默认服装) are omitted: they are the chars[].spine entries the manifest already carries.
meta.stemRule: skinId.replace(/@/g,'_').replace(/#/g,'_') === stem  (fexli directory and model file stem)
meta.avatarRule: avatar/{avatarId}.png from yuanyan3060 (180×180, ~25 KB), with '#' percent-encoded as %23. Deliberately NOT the full skin art skin/{portraitId}b.png: that is ~2.5 MB each, 435 MB for the set.
